questions.prompt:
A light on a computer comes on for 26 700 microseconds. One microsecond is 10^-6 seconds.

Work out the length of time, in seconds, that the light is on in standard form.

p is proportional to q^3. It is known that p = 24 for a particular value of q.

Find the value of p when this value of q is halved.
questions.explanation:
p = kq^3, so 24 = kq^3.
When q is halved: p = k(q/2)^3 = kq^3 / 8 = 24 / 8 = 3.

questions.prompt:
y is inversely proportional to x^2. y = 4 when x = 3.

Find y when x = 10.

A map is drawn to a scale of 1 : 50 000.

The actual area of the airport is 3.5 km^2. Calculate the area on the map which represents the airport, giving your answer in square centimetres.

Express as a single fraction in its simplest form:

2x/(x^2 - 4) + 5/(2 - x).

questions.explanation:
Need two terms multiplying to 5x^2 and summing to -6xy.
(y - 5x)(y - x) = y^2 - xy - 5xy + 5x^2 = y^2 - 6xy + 5x^2.

questions.prompt: Given that (x^5 x x^0) / sqrt(x) = x^k, find k.

Simplify, expressing your answer in positive index:

(x^27 / 27)^(2/3).

Simplify, expressing your answer in positive index:

(27/7) / (p^2 / 3)^(-1).

The expression x^2 - 10x + 17 can be written in the form (x - 5)^2 + n.

Find the value of n.
questions.explanation:
(x - 5)^2 + n = x^2 - 10x + 25 + n.
Compare constant terms: 25 + n = 17, so n = -8.

questions.prompt:
The expression x^2 - 10x + 17 can be written as (x - 5)^2 - 8.

Explain why when x = 5, the expression x^2 - 10x + 17 has its minimum value.
questions.model_answer: (x - 5)^2 >= 0, so the expression is smallest when (x - 5)^2 = 0, i.e. when x = 5.
questions.explanation:
x^2 - 10x + 17 = (x - 5)^2 - 8.
(x - 5)^2 is never negative and is zero when x = 5.
So the minimum value occurs at x = 5.

questions.prompt:
Given that n is an integer and n > 1, decide whether each statement is true or false. If false, give a counter-example.

(i) n^3 > 1
(ii) 1/n > 1/n^2
(iii) (n - 1)(n + 3) is always odd
questions.model_answer: (i) True (ii) True (iii) False; e.g. n = 3 gives (2)(6) = 12 which is even
questions.explanation:
(i) For n > 1, n^3 > 1.
(ii) For n > 1, 1/n > 1/n^2 since n > 1.
(iii) When n = 3, (n - 1)(n + 3) = 2 x 6 = 12, which is even, so the statement is false.
